definitions.explanation: a person devoted to study and learning, especially in an academic or scholarly context

notes:
A formal and somewhat literary word for students or scholars. Most strongly associated with the historical term {学徒|がくと}⟦{動員|どういん}→動員：11927_douin⟧ (student mobilization), which refers to the conscription of university students into military service during World War II.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学徒|がくと}⟦{動員|どういん}→動員：11927_douin⟧: student mobilization (WWII term)
- {学徒|がくと}⟦{出陣|しゅつじん}→出陣：19165_shutsujin⟧: students going off to war
- ⟦{法学|ほうがく}→法学：28413_hougaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学徒|がくと}: student of law

ETYMOLOGY:
{学徒|がくと}⟦{動員|どういん}→動員：11927_douin⟧ (1943-1945) was a wartime policy that drafted university and higher school students into factories and eventually into combat. It remains a significant topic in Japanese war history and is frequently referenced in historical discussions and memorials.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧: student — the standard modern word for a student
- ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧: pupil, student — used mainly for secondary school students
- ⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧: scholar — an established academic or researcher
